narthex.desc: Small stone entry hall. Holy water font, notice board, heavy oak door to the street.

nave.desc: Rows of worn wooden pews under a timber roof. Morning light through stained glass. The rear pews smell of beeswax polish.

sanctuary.desc: Raised altar of pale stone, candle stands, a carved wooden screen. A side door leads to the sacristy.

sacristy.desc: Cramped room of vestment cupboards and a wash basin. A low iron-banded door in the corner leads down.

crypt.desc: Low vaulted cellar of old tombs, directly beneath the altar. Damp and cold.

crypt_key.desc: Iron key on a cord around Father Aldric's neck, under his cassock.

loose_stone.desc: A stone in the north wall below the altar that slides out if pressed at the lower left corner.
loose_stone.find: WIS -4 when searching the north wall

reliquary.desc: Palm-sized tarnished silver box holding the knuckle bone of St. Aurel.

chalice.desc: Silver chalice being polished for mass.

parish_register.desc: Old leather ledger. An entry from 1961 notes 'relic moved below for safekeeping'.

truth: The Reliquary of St. Aurel is real and hidden behind the loose stone in the crypt.
Only Father Aldric knows its location. He was told by the previous priest, Father Benedict, in 1989.
Agnes saw Father Benedict carry a small silver box down to the crypt about forty years ago and has never mentioned it.
